text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold A, D, and E after gains, but a profitable sale is not automatically a good decision; I should weigh each stock’s future risk and return rather than anchor on my cost or a gain I can lock in.","After selling, I bought A, D, and E again. Familiarity and recent price history are not evidence of future performance, so I should make each buy decision afresh.","My account rose overall despite several down months and no trades in periods 6–10. I should assess progress at the portfolio level, stay diversified, and avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations."]}
